dedupe_keys.name: u s hydropower development pipeline data 2026 ornl hydrosource

description: The U.S. Hydropower Development Pipeline Data, 2026 is a dataset from Oak Ridge National Laboratory's HydroSource giving a regularly updated view of proposed and potential hydropower projects across the United States. It compiles federal agency and public information on non-powered dams considered for electrification, proposed facilities on reaches without dams, conduit exemptions and emerging pumped storage proposals, with location, development status, technology type and ownership, as of 31 December 2025, and is updated annually with cancelled and completed projects removed. Coverage: national, planned and permitted projects only; capacity additions at existing plants are excluded because of a proprietary source. Access: free from HydroSource with a DOI, and companion pipeline maps; the licence and file format were not stated on the page read. Caveats: a proposal list, so many entries never get built. It supports capacity planning for future dams and reservoirs, and relates to the Global Dam Watch database and GloHydroRes hydropower reservoir records already in the catalogue.
